logp.method_description: The traditional shake-flask method was used to obtain the distribution coefficient of the complex in n-octanol/buffered aqueous solution (10 mM HEPES, pH = 7.4) using UV–vis spectrophotometry. The measurements and data evaluation were performed as in our previous work. (93)
